description: This file defines function declarations related to various neural network operations such as convolution, linear layers, pooling, and activations within the at::native::xnnpack namespace. It includes functions to determine whether certain optimized implementations can be used and functions to perform these operations, mostly with Tensor inputs.

methods.name: use_convolution2d
methods.description: Determines if a 2D convolution operation can be implemented with optimized routines based on input tensor, weight, bias sizes, padding, stride, dilation, groups, and transposed flag.

methods.name: convolution2d
methods.description: Performs a 2D convolution operation with given input, weight, bias, and convolution parameters.

methods.name: use_linear
methods.description: Checks if a linear (fully connected) layer operation can be optimized for given input, weight, and bias tensors.

methods.name: linear
methods.description: Executes a linear transformation with provided input, weight, and bias tensors.

methods.name: use_max_pool2d
methods.description: Checks if max pooling operation can be optimized for specific input size and parameters.

methods.name: max_pool2d
methods.description: Performs 2D max pooling with specified parameters.

methods.name: use_global_average_pool
methods.description: Determines if global average pooling optimization applies to the input tensor.

methods.name: global_average_pool
methods.description: Performs global average pooling on the input tensor.

methods.name: use_channel_shuffle
methods.description: Checks if channel shuffle operation is appropriate for the input and number of groups.

methods.name: channel_shuffle
methods.description: Executes a channel shuffle operation on the input tensor.

methods.name: use_hardswish
methods.description: Checks if the hardswish activation function can be used with the input tensor.

methods.name: hardswish
methods.description: Applies the hardswish activation to the input tensor.

methods.name: hardswish_
methods.description: In-place version of the hardswish activation function.
